player_prompt.intro:
Kdigi d umarir {player_id} di Tic Tac Toe Quantum.
Ayya-nnek d '{symbol}', yiwet n wučči-inek d {parity} (s umdya, X1, X3 neɣ O2, O4).

Tiddi: Rbeḥ s tsebbelt n kraḍ idrimen klasikin (yettwaggzen seg usufeɣ).

Amek i wawalen:
- Di krayat n yal tikkelt, ṣekk d azbu annect-ak di sin n yimezdaɣen imlanen s unmuyla '[a,b]'.
- Ayya idrimen ttunfeɣen, yiwet n wučči-nsen am 'X1 / X1' neɣ 'O4 / O4'.
- Ur tzemreḍ ad tesekk d azbu annect-ak di yimezdaɣen iɣelnawen (yettwaggzen).

Tajmaɛt n usufeɣ:
- Ma yella tikkelt-inek tessuffeɣ-d deg usufeɣ n wučči, ad tettwaggz s yiman-is.
- Krayat n azbu annect-ak deg usufeɣ ad ttbinen d idrimen klasikin di yiwet n sin n yimezdaɣen-nsen.
- Ayya idrimen ittunfeɣen daɣen ad ttbinen.

Tiddi n rbeḥ:
- Ad taggze tawla ma yella umarir iɣla kraḍ idrimen klasikin di kra.
- Ma yella sin n wemdanen iɣlan kraḍ idrimen di kra n usufeɣ, win iɣelnayen s uqettal n wučči meẓẓiyen ad irbeḥ.

Umdya n tikkelt: '[0,4]' ad tessuffeɣ d azbu annect-ak di yimezdaɣen 0 yakked 4.
